basis.list_date: a list stored under one date; that date is the list's date
basis.changed: a nightly fetch of a live list whose players, ranks or grades differ from the previous fetch
basis.first_fetch: the first fetch of a live list on record

note: Dates are the database's snapshot dates. A refetched list keeps one row per player dated the last fetch that carried him, so it carries no publication date and is listed under refetched instead.
